art_instructions: Draw a medium shot from eye level showing Panda standing alone in a cozy, softly lit room. Panda looks visibly upset, with downturned eyes and a small frown on her muzzle. Her round face shows a slight pout, and her ears droop slightly to convey sadness. Position her in the center of the frame, with her tiny white belly and dark eye patches clearly visible. Her black ear tufts should be expressive, tilted downward to enhance the emotional tone. Keep the background simple, with soft pastel tones and minimal details to focus attention on Panda's emotional state. No other characters are present; the scene should feel quiet and lonely to reflect the text's meaning.
